description:
We love to create/do stuff.

For NASA’s “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map” challenge, we tackled one gap. Mars maps show the whole planet, but a walking astronaut needs the next 2 km: which ground is safe, how long walks take in a suit, and whether there’s enough oxygen to get back. ARIADNE turns real NASA data into a tablet map and helmet display that plans safe routes to science stops and draws the Thread, a live boundary of how far the astronaut can go and still return to the rover.
